questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
______ intelligence allows computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
questions.explanation: “Artificial intelligence” (AI) = trí tuệ nhân tạo.

A ______ is a computer program that can talk with people through text or voice.

questions.stem:

Some people worry that robots will ______ humans in many jobs.
questions.explanation: replace = thay thế; robot có thể thay thế con người trong nhiều công việc.

questions.explanation: “social media” = mạng xã hội; trước danh từ “media” cần tính từ “social”.

questions.stem:

questions.topic: Unit 6 – Grammar: Active and passive causatives

Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
I had my laptop ______ by a technician yesterday.
questions.explanation: Thể nhờ vả bị động: have + vật + V3 (+ by sb) → had my laptop repaired.

questions.stem:

questions.stem:

questions.stem:

The ranger told us ______ the animals.
questions.explanation: Tường thuật mệnh lệnh phủ định: tell sb not to + V.

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The tourist asked the guide ______.
options: how many elephants lived in the park
how many did elephants live in the park
how many elephants did live in the park
how many elephants do live in the park
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi tường thuật dùng trật tự câu khẳng định (không đảo trợ động từ) và lùi thì: how many elephants lived in the park.

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Student: “Can you show me how to use this AI app?”
Teacher: “______”
options: Sure. Just type your question here.
questions.explanation: Đáp lại lời nhờ giúp → đồng ý và hướng dẫn: “Sure. Just type your question here.”

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Minh: “I think AI will make our lives much easier.”
Lan: “______”
options: That's true, but it also brings some risks.
questions.explanation: Đáp lại một nhận định → đồng ý một phần và bổ sung ý kiến.

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Minh: Where did you read it?
b. Lan: I've just read that all motorbikes will be banned in the city next month.
c. Lan: On a page someone shared on social media.
d. Minh: Hmm, you should check reliable news websites. It could be fake news.
questions.explanation: Lan đưa tin (b) → Minh hỏi đọc ở đâu (a) → Lan trả lời trên mạng xã hội (c) → Minh khuyên kiểm tra, có thể là tin giả (d).

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. However, AI also raises concerns about job losses and privacy.
b. For instance, it can help doctors detect diseases earlier and more accurately.
c. Artificial intelligence is changing many areas of our lives.
d. Therefore, we need clear rules to make sure it is used responsibly.
questions.explanation: Câu chủ đề (c) → ví dụ lợi ích “For instance” (b) → mặt trái “However” (a) → kết luận “Therefore” (d).

questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is no longer something we only see in science fiction films. It has become part of our daily lives. When we ask a virtual assistant about the weather, use a translation app or receive film recommendations on a streaming service, we are using AI.

AI is also changing education. Some schools now use AI-powered apps that can identify each student's strengths and weaknesses and then suggest suitable exercises. Students can get feedback on their writing in seconds instead of waiting days for their teacher to mark it. Chatbots can also answer students' questions at any time of the day.

However, many teachers are concerned about the misuse of AI. Some students simply ask chatbots to write their essays instead of doing the work themselves. As a result, they do not develop important skills such as critical thinking and problem-solving. Another problem is that AI tools sometimes give wrong information, so users need to check the facts carefully.

Experts believe that AI should be used as a tool to support learning, not to replace it. Students should learn how to use AI responsibly, and teachers should guide them to use it in a creative and honest way. If used wisely, AI can make learning more personal and effective.

What is the passage mainly about?
options: The use of AI in daily life and education, with its benefits and risks
Why teachers should stop using technology
The history of science fiction films
questions.explanation: Bài nói AI trong đời sống, trong giáo dục, những lo ngại khi lạm dụng và lời khuyên dùng AI có trách nhiệm.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
My parents (A) had a robot vacuum cleaner (B) deliver (C) to our house (D) last week.
questions.explanation: Thể nhờ vả bị động: have + vật + V3 → deliver → delivered.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
The guide (A) asked us (B) whether we (C) have ever seen a wild elephant (D) before.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi tường thuật với động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ phải lùi thì: have ever seen → had ever seen.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
A mechanic repaired my car yesterday.
options: I repaired my car by a mechanic yesterday.
I had my car repairing by a mechanic yesterday.
I had my car repaired by a mechanic yesterday.
I had a mechanic repaired my car yesterday.
questions.explanation: Thể nhờ vả bị động: have + vật + V3 + by sb; “have + người” phải đi với V nguyên mẫu (had a mechanic repair).

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
“Don't touch the baby turtles,” the ranger said to us.
options: The ranger said us not to touch the baby turtles.
The ranger told us not touching the baby turtles.
The ranger told us not to touch the baby turtles.
The ranger told us to touch the baby turtles.
questions.explanation: Tường thuật mệnh lệnh phủ định: tell sb not to + V; “say” không đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ chỉ người.
